text: I can decide between a fixed workflow and an agent for a task, using the compounding per-step success arithmetic.
I can draw the tool-calling loop and show where argument validation, permission checks and limits are enforced in the orchestrator.
I can compute how input tokens grow over an agent run and design checkpoints that let a run resume after a crash or a pause.
I can make a side-effecting tool safe to retry with orchestrator-generated idempotency keys, including when the model repeats the call itself.
I can set step, token, time and per-tool limits plus loop detection, and say what the agent returns when each is hit.
I can choose which actions need human approval and design an approval step that shows the exact effect and resists rubber-stamping.
